resources.string: Package Manager
Relax app installation and update checks
Enable Core Patch
Choose the core checks to relax below. Turning this off restores the original checks for new installs and keeps your selections.
Core patches
Additional install options
Allow app downgrades
Install an older version over a newer one without uninstalling it first.
Allow re-signed app updates
Update an app with an APK signed by a different key; the app keeps its data.
Disable package manager signature verification
Install modified APKs, v1-only APKs, or APKs with compressed resource tables.
Disable system integrity checks
Prohibit automatic recovery of modified content.
Allow mismatched split signatures
Install a base APK and its split APKs even when their signatures differ.
Allow apps for older Android versions
Install apps that target an Android version the system normally blocks.
Skip install verification service
Do not ask the system verification service to check new installs.
Allow updating persistent apps
Update apps that the system normally treats as always running.
Allow blocked system app updates
Skip HyperOS restrictions on updating certain preinstalled apps.
Skip HyperOS install isolation
Skip HyperOS checks based on install source or device rules.
